description: A caseworker needs to turn a long first conversation into a concise intake summary with immediate action items, existing supports, unresolved questions, and realistic next-contact priorities. All organizations and client names are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 30-year-old caseworker balancing empathy with heavy administrative load
user_profile.context: The first conversation contained important details, but too much was said to rely on memory alone
user_profile.communication_style: Service-oriented and structured, wants a concise record that still preserves nuance

fact_sheet.fact: The client's full name is Maria Flores.
Maria Flores's date of birth is July 15, 1988.
Maria Flores's assigned case ID is MF-2024-0521.
The initial intake interview was conducted by caseworker Alex Chen on May 21, 2024.
Maria Flores was referred by the Eastwood Community Food Bank.
Maria Flores's primary contact phone number is 555-0182.
Maria Flores is currently residing at the Harmony House Shelter, located at 450 River Street.
She has been staying at the Harmony House Shelter since May 9, 2024.
Maria Flores was evicted from her previous apartment at 123 Oak Lane, Apt 2B, on May 8, 2024.
The reason for eviction was failure to pay rent for March and April 2024.
Maria Flores is currently unemployed.
Her last place of employment was as a cashier at Greenleaf Market.
Her last day of work at Greenleaf Market was February 28, 2024, due to the store's closure.
Maria Flores applied for SNAP benefits online via the state portal on May 20, 2024.
She has an outstanding utility bill of $215.45 with Apex Power & Light.

Her current medication is Metformin 500mg, taken twice daily with meals.
Her last prescription refill was from Wellspring Pharmacy on April 30, 2024.

She has a scheduled appointment with Dr. Evans at the Riverbend Medical Clinic for June 5, 2024.
Maria's primary emergency contact is her sister, Sofia Reyes.
Sofia Reyes's phone number is 555-0199.

It is currently unknown if Maria Flores's previous income level qualifies her for the Section 8 housing voucher waitlist.
A signed release of information form is needed to obtain medical records from her previous physician, Dr. Ames.

user_needs.description: What is the client's full name and assigned case ID?
How was the client referred to us and what is her primary phone number?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After identifying the client, confirming contact and referral source is the next logical step in basic intake.

user_needs.description: Where is the client currently living and since what date?
What was the reason for her eviction from her previous apartment?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: Understanding that the client is in a shelter naturally leads to questioning the circumstances of her prior housing loss.

user_needs.description: What is her employment status and where did she last work?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Cross-group: Learning the eviction was due to failure to pay rent directly prompts an inquiry into her employment and income situation.

user_needs.description: Has she applied for any financial assistance like SNAP benefits?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After establishing unemployment, the next logical question is what steps have been taken to secure alternative income or benefits.

user_needs.description: What are the client's documented physical and mental health diagnoses?
What medication is she prescribed for her Type 2 Diabetes?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: A diagnosis of Type 2 Diabetes immediately prompts a follow-up question about current treatment and medication.

user_needs.description: Who is listed as her emergency contact?
Does she participate in any community support groups?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Cross-group: Learning about the client's anxiety diagnosis (GAD) can prompt the caseworker to inquire about existing community or peer supports.

user_needs.description: What are my immediate action items for housing and mental health referrals, and what are their deadlines?
What is needed to obtain the client's previous medical records?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Cross-group: After summarizing the client's health conditions, a caseworker would proactively identify blockers to comprehensive care, such as missing medical records.

user_needs.description: What is still unknown about Maria Flores's eligibility for the Section 8 housing voucher waitlist?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Cross-group: After noting the action item to contact the housing authority, the caseworker would specify the key question that needs to be answered by that call.

user_needs.description: When is the next follow-up meeting scheduled with the client?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Cross-group: Defining the immediate action items naturally leads to confirming the date and time of the next client touchpoint to review progress.

user_needs.description: What is the main priority for the next client meeting?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: Once the date of the next meeting is established, the immediate follow-up is to define its primary goal or agenda item.
